metadata.title: Algorithm Verification Experiment
metadata.description: Baseline verification of three-channel correlation algorithm under ideal conditions
metadata.purpose: Verify core algorithm implementation correctness with perfect synchronization
metadata.reference: Xu Weiwei et al. (2017) - Multi-channel correlation analysis for broadband seismometer self-noise detection

signal_parameters.description: Signal model: X_i(t) = S(t) + N_i(t), where S(t) is common signal and N_i(t) is independent noise
signal_parameters._unit_conversion_note: Units converted from V/sqrt(Hz) to ng/sqrt(Hz) using conversion factor 6.4071e+09 (sensitivity=1 V/(m/s), frequency=10 Hz)

welch_parameters.description: Welch method for power spectral density estimation with 87.5% overlap

synchronization_delays.description: No synchronization error (ideal case) - perfect alignment between channels

test_conditions.note: Config uses V/sqrt(Hz) units; ng/sqrt(Hz) values are conceptual references only

expected_outcomes.algorithm_behavior: Should correctly separate signal and noise components
expected_outcomes.symmetry_properties: Results should exhibit mathematical symmetry across channel permutations
expected_outcomes.numerical_stability: No negative values, NaN, or infinity in computed self-noise
validation_criteria: Self-noise estimates close to true noise level (1e-6 V/sqrt(Hz))
Consistent results across all 6 channel permutations
No computational artifacts or numerical instabilities
